name: Large Print Pack
description: The Large Print Pack is a collection of word search puzzles designed to be easy on the eyes. Grids are smaller, letters are bigger, and contrast is high, so you can enjoy a puzzle comfortably on a phone, tablet or desktop screen. Words run across and down only, and the themes stay gentle: gardens, kitchens, seasons, travel and quiet everyday pleasures. These free large print word searches are popular with seniors, readers who prefer bigger type, and anyone who wants a calm, unhurried break. There is no timer, no download and no account needed. Simply tap the first and last letter of a word, or drag across it, to mark it found.
